title: Subjunctive
rule: Після дієслів suggest, recommend, insist, demand, propose та виразів на кшталт it is essential that вживаємо базову форму дієслова без -s: I suggest that he review it; It is essential that she be here. Після it's (high) time та would rather підмет йде в Past Simple: It's time we went. I'd rather you didn't.

items.prompt: I suggest that he ___ the code before merging.
items.explanation: Після suggest that — базова форма дієслова (subjunctive).

items.prompt: The manager insisted that every developer ___ the security training.
items.explanation: Після insist that — базова форма без -s.

items.prompt: It's high time we ___ the legacy system.
items.explanation: It's high time + Past Simple про дію, яку давно слід було зробити.

items.prompt: I'd rather we ___ the meeting to Friday.
items.explanation: I'd rather + підмет + Past Simple про теперішнє/майбутнє.

items.prompt: It is essential that passwords never ___ stored in plain text.
items.explanation: Після it is essential that — базова форма be.

items.prompt: The doctor recommended that she ___ more water.
If I ___ you, I'd ask for a raise.
items.explanation: В порадах If I were you — форма were для всіх осіб.

items.prompt: The recruiter demanded that the candidate ___ present on time.
items.explanation: Після demand that — базова форма be.

items.prompt: It's about time we ___ (start) the deployment.
She suggested that he ___ (not / use) global variables.
items.explanation: Заперечення в subjunctive — not + базова форма.

items.prompt: I'd rather you ___ (not / push) directly to main.
items.explanation: I'd rather + підмет + Past Simple (заперечення — didn't).

items.prompt: The lead insisted that the release ___ (be) postponed.
items.explanation: Після insist that — базова форма be (або should be).

items.prompt: I suggest that he goes to the doctor.
answers: I suggest that he go to the doctor.
I suggest that he should go to the doctor.
items.explanation: Після suggest that дієслово без закінчення -s.

items.prompt: It's time we go home; it's almost midnight.
answers: It's time we went home; it's almost midnight.
It is time we went home; it's almost midnight.
items.explanation: It's time + підмет вимагає Past Simple.

items.prompt: My boss insisted that I am at the meeting.
answers: My boss insisted that I be at the meeting.
My boss insisted that I should be at the meeting.
items.explanation: Після insist that вживаємо be, а не am.
